topic: What happens if you stop eating for three days?
title: What going without food does
hook: What happens if you stop eating for three days?

beats.label: 12 HOURS
beats.line: After twelve hours, your stomach can growl, and hunger comes in waves.

beats.label: 24 HOURS
beats.line: A day in, your stored sugar runs low, so your body burns fat.

beats.label: 2 DAYS
beats.line: By day two, you may feel tired, cranky, and a little dizzy.

beats.label: 3 DAYS
beats.line: By day three, ketones supply about a third of your brain's energy.

end.line: What's the longest you've gone without food?

description: Hour by hour: how your body switches from sugar to fat and ketones when you stop eating.

facts.claim: The hunger hormone ghrelin rises around usual mealtimes and then falls, so hunger comes and goes in waves; an empty stomach can growl.
facts.source: NIH / PubMed (Natalucci et al., Eur J Endocrinol 2005)

facts.claim: Liver glycogen (stored sugar) is largely used up within about a day of fasting, and the body shifts to burning fat.
facts.source: NIH StatPearls: Physiology, Fasting / Berg, Biochemistry

facts.claim: Fatigue, irritability, headache and lightheadedness are commonly reported during short fasts.
After about three days of fasting, ketone bodies meet roughly a third of the brain's energy needs.
